name: 43540 · Metamora, OH
findings: ZIP 43540 (Metamora) has 8 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (100%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43540 (Metamora) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
